method: Built-in image_gen; ten independent character edits; no CLI
reference: One user-provided group photo: ten distinct subjects, selected only by visible position. Original photos are not copied into the website or repository. Existing project illustrations provide original clothing and rendering references.

review.scope: Visual inspection of each output for the intended subject, age variation, completeness and recognizable clothing logos/crests. Not exhaustive legal clearance.
review.clothing: Original project clothing retained, composed from ordinary laboratory coats, work jackets, aprons and everyday clothing. Photo clothing labels and accessories are not reproduced.
review.likeness: Roughly seventy-percent likeness requested as an artistic direction, not a measured or legally meaningful threshold. Older characters are age-progressed interpretations.
review.limits: No promise of zero copyright or personality-rights risk. References and generated images do not establish exclusive copyright or replace consent from depicted people.
review.status: All ten generated PNGs visually inspected: separate reference subjects, distinct facial styling, young/middle/older appearance, complete head and shoes, and no observed brand text or recognizable institutional crest. Runtime alpha and dimensions verified during WebP encoding. This is a visual review, not legal clearance.
